text:
maria_cs: Heads up — Hydra just signed 3 new product squads and want to onboard them next month. They estimate an immediate +3x qps on chat endpoints and want embeddings for search. Renewal conversations look positive but they asked about dedicated capacity and a short pilot for isolation.
priya_ae: Nice. Do we have rough numbers from them? qps by endpoint and embedding batch sizes?
maria_cs: Hydra sent this in the kickoff: 

```
expected_chat_qps: 120 -> 360
avg_tokens_per_chat: 40
embedding_rate_per_min: 600 (bulk jobs at night)
peak_concurrency_window: 30m around 10:00 UTC
```

sam_solutions: Thanks — that's a clear expansion signal. For 3x chat qps + nightly embedding bulk, recommend Dedicated pilot w/ autoscale burst and a caching layer. Can start with a 2-week canary to validate latency and cost.
raf_infra: If we do Dedicated, we should also consider quantized model variants for embeddings (int8) and prefix caching for chat to cut token cost. I can sketch a rollout plan:

- day 1: provision 2 reserved GPUs (sustained) + 1 burst node
- day 3: enable prefix/KV cache for top routes
- day 7: switch embeddings to int8 quantized candidate and run quality evals

sam_solutions: Also propose a routing policy: primary = hosted high-throughput pool, fallback = dedicated if region mismatch, and fallthrough = smaller, cheaper model for non-critical routes.
jake_support: I'll own enablement — scheduling 3 onboarding sessions (one per squad) + a one-pager on best practices for batching embeddings and warming KV cache. Shared template: https://redwood.internal/cs/playbooks/onboard-template 
priya_ae: Hydra is sensitive about data isolation (legal), so Private deployment is on the table if Dedicated can't meet their compliance. Maria, can you get specifics on required attestations?
maria_cs: Will ping them today — asked for SOC2 scope and IP classification. Expect reply EOD.
ops-bot: Reminder: created task CS-9251 to track Hydra expansion pilot and enablement sessions.
raf_infra: One note on cost estimates — with current model mix, rough expected cost (hosted + dedicated hybrid) is ~$14k/month for the pilot; with int8 embeddings we drop to ~$9k/month. I'll attach a breakdown once I run the profiler.
sam_solutions: Good. Also flagging potential renewal uplift — if pilot succeeds, upsell path: org-wide Dedicated + prioritized support. Priya, can you lead renewal timeline alignment?
priya_ae: Yep — I'll sync with the customer on renewal cadence and propose a pilot-to-contract timeline in next call.
maria_cs: Action items: 
- @pri aE: confirm renewal timeline + compliance ask (owner: priya_ae)
- @raf_infra: cost/profile breakdown + quantization plan (owner: raf_infra)
- @jake_support: onboarding sessions + one-pager (owner: jake_support)
- @sam_solutions: draft pilot routing/rollback policy (owner: sam_solutions)
- me: collect legal docs from Hydra and confirm start date

Will post updates here when I have the SOC2 scope. :thumbsup:
